garis pangkal zon maritim Malaysia.

BASELINES OF MARITIME ZONES ACT 2006

BASELINES OF MARITIME ZONES (DECLARATION OF GEOGRAPHICAL
COORDINATES OF BASE POINTS) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 4 of the
Baselines of Maritime Zones Act 2006 [ Act 660 ], the Yang di -Pertuan Agong ,
on the recommendation of the Minister, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Baselines of Maritime Zones
(Declaration of Geographical Coordinates of Base Points) Order 2022.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 1 July 2022.

Declaration of geographical coordinates of base points
2. Yang di-Pertuan Agong declares the geographical coordinates of base points
of the areas as specified in the Schedule for the purpose of determining the baselines
of the maritime zones of Malaysia.
